vopros: What's the best AI receptionist for a small business?

vyzhimka.tekst:
For most small businesses, my top pick right now is Smith.ai, especially when every inbound call can turn into meaningful revenue. Its AI receptionist answers 24/7, qualifies leads, schedules appointments, routes calls, records/transcribes conversations, and can escalate beyond pure AI when needed. There's also a free tier with 25 calls/month; paid AI plans start around $150/month. ([smith.ai](https://smith.ai/pricing/ai-receptionist?utm_source=openai))

A few alternatives are better in specific situations:

- Smith.ai — Best overall for lead-driven businesses like law firms, contractors, agencies, real estate, and professional services. The AI/human options are the big differentiator. ([smith.ai](https://smith.ai/pricing/ai-receptionist?utm_source=openai))
- Goodcall — Best value for appointment/service businesses. Plans start at $79/month on current monthly pricing, with unlimited minutes but limits based on unique customers. It supports scheduling, routing, FAQs, and custom call flows. ([goodcall.com](https://www.goodcall.com/pricing?utm_source=openai))
- RingCentral AI Receptionist — Best if you want your receptionist integrated into a broader business phone system. It can answer and route calls, handle texts and overflow, book appointments, and integrate with tools such as Calendly. Standalone AIR currently starts at $49/month for 100 minutes; RingEX customers can add it starting at $39/month. ([ringcentral.com](https://www.ringcentral.com/us/en/blog/ai-receptionist-texts-call-queues-integrations/?utm_source=openai))

The biggest distinction isn't which AI has the most impressive demo; it's whether it can reliably perform the actions your callers need. For a plumber, that might be determining whether it's an emergency and booking service. For a law firm, it's intake and consultation scheduling. For a salon, it's appointments, pricing, and hours.

If you tell me what type of business you have, roughly how many calls you receive per month, and what you need the receptionist to do (book appointments, take payments, transfer calls, answer FAQs, etc.), I can narrow this down to the best 2–3 options and compare their actual monthly cost.
